policies.current: Existing computer policy for all four factions
policies.factory: Factory expansion with supply repairs; usual front weights
policies.military: Drone/modernization investment; concentrate 80% on the primary front
policies.research: Research labs/programs with supply repairs; usual front weights
policies.cooperation: Offer agreements and shared benefits, zero tariffs, outreach and civic/infrastructure investment
policies.objective: Support military production and forecast allocations across the faction's complete objectives
policies.objective-industry: Objective policy with a larger early factory investment before sustained military production
